written.headline: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory security products
written.summary: OpenAI launched two security products under its Daybreak platform: Daybreak Red Team in early access to test web applications for flaws, and Daybreak Defense Factory to automate finding, validating, and fixing vulnerabilities at scale. The tools rely on OpenAI models such as GPT-6 Cyber.

written.headline: Nscale says it needs extra funding for 2027 commitments after $45B Anthropic chip order
written.summary: Nvidia‑backed cloud provider Nscale disclosed it must raise additional financing to meet 2027 obligations after ordering Nvidia chips for a $45 billion Anthropic contract, putting its planned $35 billion IPO in doubt. Its updated IPO prospectus shows Q3 revenue of $307.5 million and a net loss of $1.69 billion.

written.headline: Mirendil raises $1 billion Series A led by Kleiner Perkins and Clearlake Capital
written.summary: AI lab Mirendil raised a $1 billion Series A funding round led by Kleiner Perkins and Clearlake Capital. The fundraise comes six months after the company announced a $200 million seed round.

written.headline: MeitY questions home services platforms over in-home video data collection for AI
written.summary: MeitY convened a consultation with home services platforms and robotics companies to examine the collection of in-home video footage by gig workers to train physical AI models. The ministry questioned platforms regarding data-sharing contracts, retention periods, worker consent, privacy protections, and payment.

written.headline: Samsung in talks to buy data center cooling firm Modine
written.summary: Samsung is in talks to acquire Modine Manufacturing, a US maker of data center cooling systems, in a potential deal that could come together as soon as the coming weeks. Modine had a market value of $5.6 billion, and its shares surged 29% in extended trading following the report.
